Subject: MAP update and potential close delay

Kim —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. I wanted to flag that internal security had a follow-up on data residency and the SOC snapshot — they asked for an evidence packet and a short demo of private deployment options. That has pushed our internal evaluation committee meeting from 4/20 to 4/30, which puts the current close window at risk.

Short asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a 1-hour private deploy demo (on-prem pattern) next week?
- Any credit/contract flexibility if the close slips beyond May 5? Procurement will want options.

cc'ing Noah from procurement who will own the formal ask.

Thanks,
Ally

Ally —

Appreciate the heads up and the MAP file. We've seen this pattern a few times (security -> calendar drift) and there are a couple of practical ways to keep momentum without compromising controls. Quick plan: 

1) Schedule the private deployment demo (30–45m) during your technical gate week. Jonas can lead a scoped demo focused on evidence and configuration (PKI/KMS, VPC endpoints, audit logs).
2) Propose a staged acceptance: Limited Prod (feature subset) on pass of the security gate, full acceptance after go-live validation. That should let you start pilot traffic while checks finish.
3) For commercial flexibility: Marissa and I can offer a conditional credit holdback proposal (one-time credit tied to an agreed slip threshold) — we'd need procurement to sign a simple amendment.

I attached a redline of the SOW that includes the staged acceptance section and an example credit clause. Can you confirm the new evaluation window (4/30) and whether Novara can commit to the demo on 4/19 or 4/22?

If yes, I'll loop in Rishi (cc'd by name in the next message) to pre-clear the credit ladder so we can shorten approvals.

—Kim

Happy to run the demo. Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: intro + goals for the session
- 10m: private deployment architecture + evidence locations (audit logs, KMS/HSM access patterns)
- 15m: quick walkthrough of the admin console (audit trails, token access, region pinning)

Proposed slots: Thu 4/19 10:00–10:45 PT or Mon 4/22 14:00–14:45 PT. Which works best?

Kim / Ally —

Thanks for the quick responses and the redline. Procurement's position: they will accept staged acceptance if commercial exposure is limited. Practically that means Novara needs either a guaranteed rollback window or a one-time credit if the contract signature shifts past 05/05. We asked legal for the amendment language; they're recommending a capped credit (percentage of first-year fees) tied to the confirmed new close date.

We're trying to avoid a hard stop on the project; a conditional credit + staged acceptance would be acceptable. However, any credit will need an internal exec approval before procurement signs — can Redwood pre-clear the credit band so we can route a single approval instead of a multi-step procurement escalation?

Also: can Jonas confirm that the evidence packet will include the KMS config export and a sanitized audit log? That's a check from our security team.

Noah Patel
Sourcing Manager — Novara Health

Team —

Summary and asks (for internal sign-off):
- Novara's evaluation committee moved to 4/30; procurement wants a staged acceptance + conditional credit if signature slips past 05/05.
- Jon has confirmed evidence pack capabilities (SOC snapshot, KMS export, sanitized audit logs) and can run the demo on 4/22 at 14:00 PT (confirmed).
- Commercial ask: procurement wants a capped credit band tied to the slip. They will route to their execs only if we can confirm a pre-cleared band.

Internal options (pick one so I can respond by EOD 4/23):
A) Pre-clear a one-time credit up to 7% of year-one ARR for slips > 30 days (requires Rishi finance note and Marissa commercial approval).
B) Offer a service-level escrow (no credit) with operational rollback guarantees and 30-day extension on onboarding milestones.
C) Hybrid: 3% credit + escrow option.

Please reply with APPROVE A / APPROVE B / APPROVE C or QUESTIONS. Marissa — can you confirm if the SOW redline language looks acceptable from a go-to-market standpoint? Rishi — if A or C chosen, what is the quick approval runway?

I will respond to Novara with the selected path and attach an updated MAP and amendment template. If we don't have an answer by EOD 4/23 we risk Novara escalating to their execs and compressing our negotiation window.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
